market_price_context.summary: Chennai dance class fees commonly appear around Rs.800 to Rs.3,500 per month on guide/search snippets, with one guide citing an average hourly fee of about Rs.712.
A guide snippet for Chennai says at The Life of Dance Academy fees range from Rs.3,000 to Rs.5,000 per month depending on batch level, with flexible weekday and weekend batches.
A Justdial snippet for Chennai dance classes says fees depend on class duration, trainer experience, batch size, studio facilities and course level, rather than listing a single citywide price.

strategy.market_gap: The clearest gap is a truly convenient, adult-only evening/weekend dance option for working professionals that is openly priced and easy to try without awkwardness. Competitors either publish mixed-age programs, hide pricing, or have review issues around rude staff and poor handling of customers, so none clearly owns a polished, professional experience for 22 to 40-year-old adults after work.
strategy.positioning: After-work Bollywood, hip-hop & dance fitness for working professionals — ₹999/month
strategy.price_reason: ₹999/month sits below Life Of Dance’s ₹3000 to ₹5000 per month guide range and matches Raack Academy of Dance’s published ₹999 per month offer for dance fitness/all courses. It is also far easier to compare than competitors with on-enquiry pricing like Zero 6 Dance and Fitness Company and The Workshop Dance Company.
